task:
FIX the 50% size guard in city-session.js that blocks legitimate new file creation.

THE BUG (line 474-481): When a model WRITEs a file, there's a guard that rejects if new content < 50% of existing content. This was meant to prevent accidental truncation. But when a model is tasked with BUILD a new tool and the worktree happens to have an old version of that file from master, the guard blocks the write because the new file is shorter than the old one. The model then enters a death spiral trying PATCH (which also fails because format mismatch) and EXEC workarounds (which are fragile).

THE FIX (in executeAction, WRITE case, around line 474-481):
1. READ city-session.js lines 457-500 to understand the full WRITE case
2. If the file being written is the BUILD target from the task, skip the 50% size guard entirely
3. OR: If the model has explicitly READ the file this session (session.filesRead.has(file)), apply the guard. If NOT read (meaning model is doing a full replace), allow the write but log a warning.
4. The key insight: the 50% guard should only protect files the model is EDITING, not files the model is REPLACING.

Apply the minimal fix. COMMIT and DONE.
